_scenario: United States / default baseline. Microsoft 365 Apps installs with en-us as its single UI language.
_notes: en-us is also what you get with no build-config.json at all, and with a null or empty Language value - the token registration defaults to it. Setting it explicitly is still worth doing: the build banner then prints Language='en-us' rather than Language='en-us' (default), so the log records it as a deliberate choice.
Copy this file to build-config.json in the repository root. That filename is gitignored, so your organisation's values never end up in a commit.

ExcludedApps: null keeps the toolkit default (Access, Bing, Groove, Lync, OneDrive, Publisher, Teams). An explicit array REPLACES that set rather than adding to it - list every app you want excluded, not just the extra ones.
